answer: Aging with teeth: a new identity starts at zero weight and earns it only through sustained honest participation across many epochs, like a cedar standing through seasons before its timber counts. One honest user simply keeps showing up, but a sybil farmer must tend every fake like a vine, day after day, paying attention, compute, and fees for months before any gains weight. Like a falcon that cannot fake years of flight, instant registration buys nothing: each fake needs a long visible history, and a proven duplicate resets that history to zero.
